the use of octreotide, intra-arterially administered chemotherapy, and hepatepatic arterial chemo-embolization (HACE) can lead to significant improvement in the quality of life and overall survival of patients with unresectable metastatic carcinoid tumor.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the most significant finding was the ability to identify a group of patients with a high probability of response to therapy, and the ability to predict the likelihood of response to therapy in a group of patients that had not been previously identified to be responsive to therapy.
we have demonstrated that octreotide acetates (OA) can be used safely in the treatment of carcinoid tumor patients.
